#' GRCh38 chromosome lengths (autosomes and X)
#' @export
grch38_chrom_lengths <- c(
  `1` = 248956422, `2` = 242193529, `3` = 198295559, `4` = 190214555,
  `5` = 181538259, `6` = 170805979, `7` = 159345973, `8` = 145138636,
  `9` = 138394717, `10` = 133797422, `11` = 135086622, `12` = 133275309,
  `13` = 114364328, `14` = 107043718, `15` = 101991189, `16` = 90338345,
  `17` = 83257441, `18` = 80373285, `19` = 58617616, `20` = 64444167,
  `21` = 46709983, `22` = 50818468, X = 156040895
)

# Extended MHC, GRCh38 (Genome Reference Consortium).
MHC_GRCH38 <- list(chrom = "6", start = 28510120L, end = 33480577L)

#' Approximately LD-independent blocks
#'
#' locusmatch places every signal in a fixed partition of the genome (for
#' example the LDetect blocks of Berisa & Pickrell 2016, lifted to GRCh38, one
#' partition per ancestry). Unlike windows built around each study's own lead
#' SNPs, the partition does not move when studies are added, so signal IDs are
#' stable.
#'
#' @param x A data frame with `chrom`, `start` (0-based) and `end`, or a path
#'   to a BED file (a header line, as in the LDetect files, is skipped).
#' @return A `data.table` with `block_id`, `chrom`, `start`, `end`.
#' @export
lm_blocks <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    x <- data.table::fread(x, header = FALSE, select = 1:3,
                           col.names = c("chrom", "start", "end"))
    if (!grepl("^[0-9]+$", x$start[1])) x <- x[-1]
  }
  x <- data.table::as.data.table(x)[, .(chrom, start = as.numeric(start), end = as.numeric(end))]
  x[, chrom := toupper(sub("^chr", "", as.character(chrom), ignore.case = TRUE))]
  data.table::setorder(x, chrom, start)
  bad <- x[, any(utils::head(end, -1) > utils::tail(start, -1)), by = chrom][V1 == TRUE]
  if (nrow(bad)) stop("overlapping blocks on chromosome ", bad$chrom[1])
  x[, block_id := sprintf("%s:%.0f-%.0f", chrom, start, end)]
  data.table::setcolorder(x, "block_id")
  x[]
}

#' Evenly spaced pseudo-blocks
#'
#' A stand-in partition for examples and tests; use real LD blocks
#' ([lm_blocks()]) for analyses.
#' @param size Block size in base pairs.
#' @export
lm_even_blocks <- function(size = 1.5e6) {
  lm_blocks(data.table::rbindlist(lapply(names(grch38_chrom_lengths), function(ch) {
    s <- seq(0, grch38_chrom_lengths[[ch]], by = size)
    data.table::data.table(chrom = ch, start = s, end = pmin(s + size, grch38_chrom_lengths[[ch]]))
  })))
}

# Block IDs touched by the core variants of each CS (usually one).
assign_blocks <- function(cs, blocks) {
  core <- unique(cs[in_cs == TRUE, .(cs_id, chrom, pos0 = pos - 1, pos1 = pos - 1)])
  b <- blocks[, .(block_id, chrom, start, end = end - 1)]
  data.table::setkey(b, chrom, start, end)
  hit <- data.table::foverlaps(core, b, by.x = c("chrom", "pos0", "pos1"), nomatch = NULL)
  unique(hit[, .(cs_id, block_id)])
}

in_mhc <- function(chrom, start, end) {
  chrom == MHC_GRCH38$chrom & start <= MHC_GRCH38$end & end >= MHC_GRCH38$start
}

logsum <- function(x) {
  m <- max(x)
  m + log(sum(exp(x - m)))
}

logdiff <- function(x, y) {
  if (y >= x) return(-Inf)
  x + log1p(-exp(y - x))
}

#' Posterior probabilities of H0-H4 from aligned log Bayes factors
#'
#' Same computation as `coloc:::combine.abf()` (Giambartolomei et al. 2014;
#' Wallace 2021), used by `coloc.bf_bf()` on SuSiE single effects.
#'
#' @param l1,l2 Natural-log Bayes factors, aligned to the same variants.
#' @param p1,p2,p12 Prior probabilities that a variant is causal for trait 1,
#'   trait 2, or both.
#' @return Named numeric vector `H0..H4`.
#' @export
combine_abf <- function(l1, l2, p1 = 1e-4, p2 = 1e-4, p12 = 5e-6) {
  stopifnot(length(l1) == length(l2))
  s1 <- logsum(l1)
  s2 <- logsum(l2)
  s12 <- logsum(l1 + l2)
  lh <- c(0, log(p1) + s1, log(p2) + s2,
          log(p1) + log(p2) + logdiff(s1 + s2, s12), log(p12) + s12)
  stats::setNames(exp(lh - logsum(lh)), paste0("H", 0:4))
}

#' Colocalise two credible sets
#'
#' Uses Bayes-factor colocalisation when both sides carry per-variant lBFs
#' (variants missing from one side get lBF = 0, i.e. no evidence, so a variant
#' that is causal in one study but outside the other's credible set still
#' counts towards H3). Otherwise falls back to the PIP approximation used by
#' Open Targets (colocPIP): H4 ~ p12 * sum(pip1 * pip2),
#' H3 ~ p1 * p2 * (S1 * S2 - sum(pip1 * pip2)), normalised so H3 + H4 = 1.
#'
#' @param a,b Data frames with `variant_id`, `pip` and optionally `lbf`.
#' @param p1,p2,p12 Priors; `p12` defaults to 5e-6 for Bayes factors (coloc's
#'   default) and 1e-5 for PIPs (Open Targets' default) when left `NULL`.
#' @return A list with `h3`, `h4`, `clpp`, `method` and `n_shared`.
#' @examples
#' a <- data.frame(variant_id = c("1:100:A:G", "1:110:C:T"), pip = c(0.8, 0.2), lbf = NA)
#' b <- data.frame(variant_id = c("1:100:A:G", "1:110:C:T"), pip = c(0.6, 0.4), lbf = NA)
#' coloc_cs(a, b)$h4
#' @export
coloc_cs <- function(a, b, p1 = 1e-4, p2 = 1e-4, p12 = NULL) {
  m <- merge(data.table::as.data.table(a)[, .(variant_id, pip1 = pip, lbf1 = lbf)],
             data.table::as.data.table(b)[, .(variant_id, pip2 = pip, lbf2 = lbf)],
             by = "variant_id", all = TRUE)
  shared <- !is.na(m$pip1) & !is.na(m$pip2)
  clpp <- sum(m$pip1[shared] * m$pip2[shared])
  has_bf <- !anyNA(a$lbf) && !anyNA(b$lbf)
  if (has_bf) {
    l1 <- m$lbf1; l1[is.na(l1)] <- 0
    l2 <- m$lbf2; l2[is.na(l2)] <- 0
    pp <- combine_abf(l1, l2, p1, p2, if (is.null(p12)) 5e-6 else p12)
    return(list(h3 = unname(pp["H3"]), h4 = unname(pp["H4"]), clpp = clpp,
                method = "coloc_bf", n_shared = sum(shared)))
  }
  p12 <- if (is.null(p12)) 1e-5 else p12
  x <- pmax(ifelse(is.na(m$pip1), 0, m$pip1), 1e-16)
  y <- pmax(ifelse(is.na(m$pip2), 0, m$pip2), 1e-16)
  prod <- sum(x * y)
  h3 <- p1 * p2 * max(sum(x) * sum(y) - prod, 0)
  h4 <- p12 * prod
  list(h3 = h3 / (h3 + h4), h4 = h4 / (h3 + h4), clpp = clpp,
       method = "coloc_pip", n_shared = sum(shared))
}

#' Variant ID that matches across studies
#'
#' For SNVs the two alleles are sorted (`chr:pos:minAllele:maxAllele`), so two
#' studies coding the effect allele differently still refer to the same
#' variant. Indels keep the order given, which must be reference/alternate:
#' swapping the alleles of an indel describes a different variant (`T>TAC`
#' is an insertion, `TAC>T` a deletion). Coordinates must be on GRCh38.
#'
#' @param chrom,pos Chromosome and position.
#' @param a1,a2 The two alleles; for indels, reference then alternate.
#' @return Character vector of IDs.
#' @examples
#' canonical_variant_id("chr1", 1000, "G", "A")    # "1:1000:A:G"
#' canonical_variant_id(1, 1000, "A", "G")         # same SNV
#' canonical_variant_id(2, 500, "T", "TAC")        # insertion, kept as given
#' @export
canonical_variant_id <- function(chrom, pos, a1, a2) {
  chrom <- toupper(sub("^chr", "", as.character(chrom), ignore.case = TRUE))
  a1 <- toupper(a1)
  a2 <- toupper(a2)
  snv <- nchar(a1) == 1L & nchar(a2) == 1L
  lo <- ifelse(snv & a2 < a1, a2, a1)
  hi <- ifelse(snv & a2 < a1, a1, a2)
  paste(chrom, as.integer(pos), lo, hi, sep = ":")
}

#' Validate a table of credible sets
#'
#' One row per variant per credible set (CS). Required columns: `cs_id`,
#' `study_id`, `chrom`, `pos`, `variant_id`, `pip`. Optional: `lbf` (natural-log
#' Bayes factor of the variant in this single-effect signal; needed for
#' Bayes-factor colocalisation), `in_cs` (whether the variant belongs to the
#' credible set proper; defaults to `TRUE`), `p` (marginal p-value, used for
#' plotting).
#'
#' @param x A data.frame.
#' @return A `data.table` with normalised columns.
#' @export
lm_credible_sets <- function(x) {
  x <- data.table::as.data.table(x)
  need <- c("cs_id", "study_id", "chrom", "pos", "variant_id", "pip")
  miss <- setdiff(need, names(x))
  if (length(miss)) stop("credible sets are missing columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
  x[, chrom := toupper(sub("^chr", "", as.character(chrom), ignore.case = TRUE))]
  x[, pos := as.integer(pos)]
  if (!"lbf" %in% names(x)) x[, lbf := NA_real_]
  if (!"in_cs" %in% names(x)) x[, in_cs := TRUE]
  if (!"p" %in% names(x)) x[, p := NA_real_]
  dup <- x[, .N, by = .(cs_id, variant_id)][N > 1]
  if (nrow(dup)) stop("duplicated variants within credible set ", dup$cs_id[1])
  x[]
}

#' Validate a study table
#'
#' Required columns: `study_id`, `pub_date` (Date or "YYYY-MM-DD"). Optional:
#' `label` (shown in figures), `ancestry`, `n`.
#'
#' @param x A data.frame.
#' @return A `data.table` ordered by publication date.
#' @export
lm_studies <- function(x) {
  x <- data.table::as.data.table(x)
  miss <- setdiff(c("study_id", "pub_date"), names(x))
  if (length(miss)) stop("studies are missing columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
  x[, pub_date := as.Date(pub_date)]
  if (!"label" %in% names(x)) x[, label := study_id]
  if (anyDuplicated(x$study_id)) stop("duplicated study_id")
  data.table::setorder(x, pub_date, study_id)
  x[]
}

# One summary row per credible set: lead variant, extent, resolution, strength.
summarise_cs <- function(cs) {
  core <- cs[in_cs == TRUE]
  core[, {
    i <- which.max(pip)
    list(
      chrom = chrom[1],
      start = min(pos),
      end = max(pos),
      lead_variant = variant_id[i],
      lead_pos = pos[i],
      max_pip = pip[i],
      n_variants = .N,
      lead_logp = if (all(is.na(p))) NA_real_ else -log10(min(p, na.rm = TRUE))
    )
  }, by = .(cs_id, study_id)]
}

# Reader for the Open Targets Platform GraphQL API.
#
# Three layers, mirroring how a user builds a reference set in the app:
#   1. client      ot_query()                    - HTTP, retries, on-disk cache
#   2. discovery   ot_search_traits(), ot_studies(), lm_filter_studies()
#                                                - pick a trait, list its studies,
#                                                  or paste accessions; then filter
#   3. retrieval   ot_credible_sets(), lm_reference_from_ot()
#                                                - credible sets in locusmatch format

OT_API <- "https://api.platform.opentargets.org/api/v4/graphql"

# Measured cost limit of the API: (credible sets per page) x (locus rows per
# credible set) must stay below ~12,500.
OT_CS_PER_PAGE <- 20L
OT_LOCUS_PER_PAGE <- 500L
OT_LOCUS_SINGLE_PAGE <- 2000L
OT_ALIAS_BATCH <- 50L

ot_cache <- local({
  cache <- NULL
  function() {
    if (is.null(cache) && requireNamespace("cachem", quietly = TRUE)) {
      dir <- getOption("locusmatch.cache_dir", tools::R_user_dir("locusmatch", "cache"))
      cache <<- cachem::cache_disk(dir, max_size = 2 * 1024^3)
    }
    cache
  }
})

#' Run a GraphQL query against the Open Targets Platform
#'
#' Retries on rate limiting and server errors and caches responses on disk
#' (keyed by the query, its variables and the Platform data release, so a new
#' release is fetched afresh). The cache lives in
#' `tools::R_user_dir("locusmatch", "cache")`; set
#' `options(locusmatch.cache_dir = ...)` to move it, or `cache = FALSE` to skip it.
#'
#' @param query GraphQL query string.
#' @param variables Named list of GraphQL variables.
#' @param cache Use the on-disk cache.
#' @return The `data` element of the response, as nested lists.
#' @export
ot_query <- function(query, variables = list(), cache = TRUE) {
  store <- if (cache) ot_cache() else NULL
  key <- NULL
  if (!is.null(store)) {
    payload <- paste(ot_data_version(), query, jsonlite::toJSON(variables, auto_unbox = TRUE))
    key <- ot_hash(payload)
    hit <- store$get(key)
    if (!cachem::is.key_missing(hit)) return(hit)
  }
  body <- list(query = query)
  if (length(variables)) body$variables <- variables
  out <- if (in_webr()) ot_post_webr(body) else ot_post_httr2(body)
  if (length(out$errors)) {
    stop("Open Targets API: ", paste(vapply(out$errors, `[[`, "", "message"), collapse = "; "),
         call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (!is.null(store)) store$set(key, out$data)
  out$data
}

in_webr <- function() identical(R.version$os, "emscripten")

ot_post_httr2 <- function(body) {
  resp <- httr2::request(OT_API) |>
    httr2::req_user_agent("locusmatch (R package; https://github.com/juliaapolonio/locusmatch_app)") |>
    httr2::req_body_json(body, auto_unbox = TRUE) |>
    httr2::req_retry(max_tries = 4, is_transient = function(r) httr2::resp_status(r) %in% c(429, 500, 502, 503, 504)) |>
    httr2::req_error(is_error = function(r) FALSE) |>
    httr2::req_perform()
  if (httr2::resp_status(resp) >= 400) {
    stop("Open Targets API returned HTTP ", httr2::resp_status(resp), call. = FALSE)
  }
  httr2::resp_body_json(resp, simplifyVector = FALSE)
}

# Inside webR (R compiled to WebAssembly, e.g. the Shinylive build of the app)
# there is no curl: send a synchronous XMLHttpRequest from the webR worker.
ot_post_webr <- function(body) {
  payload <- jsonlite::toJSON(as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(body, auto_unbox = TRUE)),
                              auto_unbox = TRUE)
  js <- sprintf(
    "(() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('POST', '%s', false);
       x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json'); x.send(%s);
       return String(x.status) + '\\n' + x.responseText; })()",
    OT_API, payload
  )
  res <- getExportedValue("webr", "eval_js")(js)
  status <- as.integer(sub("\n.*", "", res))
  if (is.na(status) || status >= 400) stop("Open Targets API returned HTTP ", status, call. = FALSE)
  jsonlite::fromJSON(sub("^[^\n]*\n", "", res), simplifyVector = FALSE)
}

ot_hash <- function(x) {
  f <- tempfile()
  on.exit(unlink(f))
  writeLines(x, f, useBytes = TRUE)
  unname(tools::md5sum(f))
}

#' Open Targets Platform data release in use, e.g. "26.09"
#' @export
ot_data_version <- local({
  version <- NULL
  function() {
    if (is.null(version)) {
      d <- ot_query("{ meta { dataVersion { year month } } }", cache = FALSE)
      version <<- paste(d$meta$dataVersion$year, d$meta$dataVersion$month, sep = ".")
    }
    version
  }
})

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
null_na <- function(x, na = NA) if (is.null(x)) na else x

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Discovery
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

#' Search traits (diseases and phenotypes) by name
#'
#' Backs the trait picker of the app: type "schizo" and choose among the
#' matching EFO/MONDO terms, each shown with its number of GWAS.
#'
#' @param text Free text.
#' @param n Maximum number of hits.
#' @param count_studies Also count the GWAS mapped to each hit (one extra request).
#' @return A `data.table` with `trait_id`, `name`, `description` and, when
#'   requested, `n_studies`.
#' @examples
#' \donttest{
#' ot_search_traits("schizophrenia", n = 5)
#' }
#' @export
ot_search_traits <- function(text, n = 10, count_studies = TRUE) {
  d <- ot_query(
    "query($q: String!, $n: Int!) {
       search(queryString: $q, entityNames: [\"disease\"], page: {index: 0, size: $n}) {
         hits { id name description } } }",
    list(q = text, n = n)
  )
  hits <- d$search$hits
  if (!length(hits)) {
    return(data.table::data.table(trait_id = character(), name = character(),
                                  description = character(), n_studies = integer()))
  }
  out <- data.table::data.table(
    trait_id = vapply(hits, `[[`, "", "id"),
    name = vapply(hits, `[[`, "", "name"),
    description = vapply(hits, function(h) null_na(h$description, NA_character_), "")
  )
  if (count_studies) {
    aliases <- sprintf('t%d: studies(diseaseIds: ["%s"], page: {index: 0, size: 1}) { count }',
                       seq_len(nrow(out)), out$trait_id)
    cnt <- ot_query(paste("{", paste(aliases, collapse = "\n"), "}"))
    out[, n_studies := vapply(sprintf("t%d", seq_len(.N)),
                              function(a) as.integer(null_na(cnt[[a]]$count, 0L)), integer(1))]
  }
  out[]
}

STUDY_FIELDS <- "
  id projectId studyType traitFromSource publicationDate publicationFirstAuthor
  publicationJournal pubmedId nSamples nCases nControls hasSumstats
  diseases { id name }
  discoverySamples { ancestry sampleSize }
  ldPopulationStructure { ldPopulation relativeSampleSize }
  credibleSets(page: {index: 0, size: 1}) { count }"

#' List GWAS from Open Targets, by trait or by accession
#'
#' The two entry points of reference selection:
#'
#' * by trait (`trait_ids`, from [ot_search_traits()]), optionally including
#'   studies of descendant terms (subtypes);
#' * by accession (`accessions`): GWAS Catalog `GCST...` IDs, FinnGen or UK
#'   Biobank study IDs as used by Open Targets. Unknown IDs are reported in the
#'   `not_found` attribute.
#'
#' Narrow the result down with [lm_filter_studies()].
#'
#' @param trait_ids EFO/MONDO IDs.
#' @param accessions Study IDs.
#' @param include_descendants Include studies of descendant traits.
#' @return A `data.table`, one row per study, see Details.
#' @details Columns: `study_id`, `project`, `trait` (as reported),
#'   `mapped_traits`, `kind` (see [classify_study_kind()]), `pub_date`, `year`,
#'   `first_author`, `journal`, `pmid`, `n`, `n_cases`, `n_controls`,
#'   `ancestry` (LD populations with sample fractions, e.g. "nfe 0.82; eas 0.18"),
#'   `main_ancestry`, `ancestries`, `discovery_ancestry` (free text),
#'   `has_sumstats`, `n_credible_sets`, `label` (e.g. "Trubetskoy 2022").
#' @examples
#' \donttest{
#' st <- ot_studies(trait_ids = "MONDO_0005090")
#' table(st$kind)
#' ot_studies(accessions = c("GCST90128471", "GCST002539"))
#' }
#' @export
ot_studies <- function(trait_ids = NULL, accessions = NULL, include_descendants = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(trait_ids) == is.null(accessions)) stop("give exactly one of trait_ids or accessions")
  rows <- list()
  not_found <- character()
  if (!is.null(trait_ids)) {
    page <- 0L
    repeat {
      d <- ot_query(
        paste0("query($ids: [String!], $ind: Boolean, $p: Int!) {
           studies(diseaseIds: $ids, enableIndirect: $ind, page: {index: $p, size: 500}) {
             count rows {", STUDY_FIELDS, "} } }"),
        list(ids = as.list(trait_ids), ind = include_descendants, p = page)
      )
      rows <- c(rows, d$studies$rows)
      if (length(rows) >= d$studies$count || !length(d$studies$rows)) break
      page <- page + 1L
    }
  } else {
    accessions <- unique(trimws(accessions[nzchar(trimws(accessions))]))
    for (chunk in split(accessions, ceiling(seq_along(accessions) / OT_ALIAS_BATCH))) {
      aliases <- sprintf('s%d: study(studyId: "%s") {%s}', seq_along(chunk),
                         gsub('"', "", chunk), STUDY_FIELDS)
      d <- ot_query(paste("{", paste(aliases, collapse = "\n"), "}"))
      for (i in seq_along(chunk)) {
        r <- d[[sprintf("s%d", i)]]
        if (is.null(r)) not_found <- c(not_found, chunk[i]) else rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- r
      }
    }
    if (length(not_found)) {
      warning(length(not_found), " accession(s) not found in Open Targets: ",
              paste(utils::head(not_found, 10), collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
    }
  }
  out <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(rows, normalise_study))
  if (!nrow(out)) out <- normalise_study(NULL)[0]
  out <- unique(out, by = "study_id")
  data.table::setorder(out, pub_date, study_id, na.last = TRUE)
  data.table::setattr(out, "not_found", not_found)
  out[]
}

normalise_study <- function(r) {
  if (is.null(r)) {
    r <- list(id = NA_character_)
  }
  ld <- r$ldPopulationStructure %||% list()
  pops <- vapply(ld, function(x) null_na(x$ldPopulation, NA_character_), "")
  frac <- vapply(ld, function(x) as.numeric(null_na(x$relativeSampleSize, NA_real_)), 0)
  o <- order(-frac)
  disc <- r$discoverySamples %||% list()
  pub <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(null_na(r$publicationDate, NA_character_)))
  author <- null_na(r$publicationFirstAuthor, NA_character_)
  trait <- null_na(r$traitFromSource, NA_character_)
  data.table::data.table(
    study_id = null_na(r$id, NA_character_),
    project = null_na(r$projectId, NA_character_),
    trait = trait,
    mapped_traits = paste(vapply(r$diseases %||% list(), `[[`, "", "name"), collapse = "; "),
    kind = classify_study_kind(trait),
    pub_date = pub,
    year = as.integer(format(pub, "%Y")),
    first_author = author,
    journal = null_na(r$publicationJournal, NA_character_),
    pmid = null_na(r$pubmedId, NA_character_),
    n = as.integer(null_na(r$nSamples, NA_integer_)),
    n_cases = as.integer(null_na(r$nCases, NA_integer_)),
    n_controls = as.integer(null_na(r$nControls, NA_integer_)),
    ancestry = if (length(pops)) paste(sprintf("%s %.2f", pops[o], frac[o]), collapse = "; ") else NA_character_,
    main_ancestry = if (length(pops)) pops[o][1] else NA_character_,
    ancestries = if (length(pops)) paste(sort(unique(pops)), collapse = ",") else NA_character_,
    discovery_ancestry = paste(unique(vapply(disc, function(x) null_na(x$ancestry, ""), "")), collapse = "; "),
    has_sumstats = isTRUE(r$hasSumstats),
    n_credible_sets = as.integer(null_na(r$credibleSets$count, 0L)),
    label = study_label(author, pub, null_na(r$id, NA_character_))
  )
}

study_label <- function(author, date, id) {
  surname <- sub("\\s+\\S+$", "", author)  # "Trubetskoy V" -> "Trubetskoy"
  ifelse(is.na(author) | is.na(date), id, sprintf("%s %s", surname, format(date, "%Y")))
}

#' Classify a study by its reported trait
#'
#' A heuristic used to pre-select the "primary" GWAS of a trait. Studies are
#' mapped to a trait in Open Targets whenever the trait appears in them, which
#' also brings in cross-trait analyses ("Obesity and schizophrenia"), MTAG,
#' family-history proxies ("Biological mother: schizophrenia"), interaction
#' scans and case-case comparisons. Users can include any kind back.
#'
#' @param trait Reported trait strings.
#' @return One of `primary`, `mtag`, `family_history`, `interaction`,
#'   `case_case`, `treatment_response`, `multi_trait`.
#' @examples
#' classify_study_kind(c("Schizophrenia", "Schizophrenia (MTAG)",
#'                       "Biological mother: schizophrenia", "Obesity and schizophrenia"))
#' @export
classify_study_kind <- function(trait) {
  t <- tolower(ifelse(is.na(trait), "", trait))
  data.table::fcase(
    grepl("mtag", t), "mtag",
    grepl("^(biological|illnesses of|family history|mother|father|sibling|parent)", t), "family_history",
    grepl("interaction| x |\\(\\d+df\\)", t), "interaction",
    grepl(" vs\\.? | versus ", t), "case_case",
    grepl("response|treatment|resistan|refractory|adverse", t), "treatment_response",
    grepl(" or | and |,|;|/|cross-disorder|pleiotrop", t), "multi_trait",
    default = "primary"
  )
}

#' Filter a study table
#'
#' Applies the filters of the app's study picker. Every argument left `NULL`
#' is not applied.
#'
#' @param studies From [ot_studies()].
#' @param years Length-2 range of publication years (studies without a date
#'   are kept only when `keep_undated = TRUE`).
#' @param ancestry LD populations to keep (`nfe`, `eas`, `afr`, `amr`, `sas`,
#'   `fin`, ...).
#' @param ancestry_match `"main"`: the largest population of the study must be
#'   one of `ancestry`; `"any"`: any contributing population; `"only"`: every
#'   contributing population.
#' @param kinds Study kinds to keep (see [classify_study_kind()]).
#' @param min_cases,min_n Minimum number of cases / total sample size.
#' @param require_credible_sets Drop studies without credible sets in Open Targets.
#' @param projects Keep these projects only (e.g. `"GCST"`, `"FINNGEN_R12"`).
#' @param keep_undated See `years`.
#' @return The filtered table.
#' @examples
#' \donttest{
#' st <- ot_studies(trait_ids = "MONDO_0005090")
#' lm_filter_studies(st, years = c(2014, 2025), ancestry = "eas", min_cases = 5000)
#' }
#' @export
lm_filter_studies <- function(studies, years = NULL, ancestry = NULL,
                              ancestry_match = c("main", "any", "only"),
                              kinds = "primary", min_cases = NULL, min_n = NULL,
                              require_credible_sets = TRUE, projects = NULL,
                              keep_undated = FALSE) {
  ancestry_match <- match.arg(ancestry_match)
  s <- data.table::copy(data.table::as.data.table(studies))
  keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(s))
  if (!is.null(years)) {
    in_range <- !is.na(s$year) & s$year >= years[1] & s$year <= years[2]
    keep <- keep & (in_range | (keep_undated & is.na(s$year)))
  }
  if (!is.null(ancestry)) {
    pops <- strsplit(ifelse(is.na(s$ancestries), "", s$ancestries), ",", fixed = TRUE)
    ok <- switch(ancestry_match,
      main = s$main_ancestry %in% ancestry,
      any = vapply(pops, function(p) any(p %in% ancestry), logical(1)),
      only = vapply(pops, function(p) length(p) > 0 && all(p %in% ancestry), logical(1))
    )
    keep <- keep & ok
  }
  if (!is.null(kinds)) keep <- keep & s$kind %in% kinds
  if (!is.null(min_cases)) keep <- keep & !is.na(s$n_cases) & s$n_cases >= min_cases
  if (!is.null(min_n)) keep <- keep & !is.na(s$n) & s$n >= min_n
  if (require_credible_sets) keep <- keep & s$n_credible_sets > 0
  if (!is.null(projects)) keep <- keep & s$project %in% projects
  s[keep]
}

# Retrieval
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

LOCUS_FIELDS <- "count rows { variant { id } posteriorProbability logBF is95CredibleSet
                  pValueMantissa pValueExponent }"

#' Download credible sets from Open Targets
#'
#' Returns every credible set of the given studies in the format of
#' [lm_credible_sets()]. Variants are those Open Targets stores for each
#' credible set (its 99% set); `in_cs` marks the 95% set. SuSiE credible sets
#' carry per-variant natural-log Bayes factors (`lbf`); PICS credible sets
#' (studies with top hits only) do not, and are compared through their PIPs.
#'
#' @param study_ids Study IDs.
#' @param progress Show a progress bar (a function `f(done, total)` can also be
#'   given, which the web app uses).
#' @return A `data.table` with an attribute `cs_meta`: one row per credible set
#'   with fine-mapping method, confidence, lead variant and Open Targets QC flags.
#' @export
ot_credible_sets <- function(study_ids, progress = interactive()) {
  meta <- ot_cs_meta(study_ids)
  if (!nrow(meta)) {
    out <- lm_credible_sets(data.table::data.table(
      cs_id = character(), study_id = character(), chrom = character(), pos = integer(),
      variant_id = character(), pip = numeric()))
    data.table::setattr(out, "cs_meta", meta)
    return(out)
  }
  report <- if (is.function(progress)) progress else if (isTRUE(progress)) {
    bar <- utils::txtProgressBar(0, nrow(meta), style = 3)
    on.exit(close(bar))
    function(done, total) utils::setTxtProgressBar(bar, done)
  } else function(done, total) NULL

  chunks <- split(meta$cs_id, ceiling(seq_len(nrow(meta)) / OT_CS_PER_PAGE))
  rows <- vector("list", length(chunks))
  done <- 0L
  for (i in seq_along(chunks)) {
    d <- ot_query(
      paste0("query($ids: [String!]) {
         credibleSets(studyLocusIds: $ids, page: {index: 0, size: ", OT_CS_PER_PAGE, "}) {
           rows { studyLocusId studyId locus(page: {index: 0, size: ", OT_LOCUS_PER_PAGE, "}) {",
             LOCUS_FIELDS, "} } } }"),
      list(ids = as.list(chunks[[i]]))
    )
    rows[[i]] <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(d$credibleSets$rows, function(cs) {
      loc <- cs$locus$rows
      if (cs$locus$count > length(loc)) loc <- c(loc, ot_locus_rest(cs$studyLocusId, length(loc)))
      locus_table(cs$studyLocusId, cs$studyId, loc)
    }))
    done <- done + length(chunks[[i]])
    report(done, nrow(meta))
  }
  out <- data.table::rbindlist(rows)
  out <- lm_credible_sets(out)
  data.table::setattr(out, "cs_meta", meta)
  out
}

ot_cs_meta <- function(study_ids) {
  rows <- list()
  for (chunk in split(study_ids, ceiling(seq_along(study_ids) / 50))) {
    page <- 0L
    repeat {
      d <- ot_query(
        "query($ids: [String!], $p: Int!) {
           credibleSets(studyIds: $ids, page: {index: $p, size: 300}) {
             count rows { studyLocusId studyId finemappingMethod confidence chromosome position
                          credibleSetlog10BF purityMinR2 qualityControls variant { id rsIds }
                          l2GPredictions(page: {index: 0, size: 1}) {
                            rows { score target { approvedSymbol } } } } } }",
        list(ids = as.list(chunk), p = page)
      )
      got <- d$credibleSets$rows
      rows <- c(rows, got)
      if (!length(got) || (page + 1L) * 300L >= d$credibleSets$count) break
      page <- page + 1L
    }
  }
  data.table::rbindlist(lapply(rows, function(r) {
    l2g <- if (length(r$l2GPredictions$rows)) r$l2GPredictions$rows[[1]] else list()
    data.table::data.table(
    cs_id = r$studyLocusId, study_id = r$studyId,
    method = null_na(r$finemappingMethod, NA_character_),
    confidence = null_na(r$confidence, NA_character_),
    chrom = null_na(r$chromosome, NA_character_), lead_pos = as.integer(null_na(r$position, NA)),
    lead_variant_ot = null_na(r$variant$id, NA_character_),
    rsid = paste(unlist(r$variant$rsIds), collapse = ","),
    log10bf = as.numeric(null_na(r$credibleSetlog10BF, NA_real_)),
    purity_min_r2 = as.numeric(null_na(r$purityMinR2, NA_real_)),
    qc = paste(unlist(r$qualityControls), collapse = "; "),
    l2g_gene = null_na(l2g$target$approvedSymbol, NA_character_),
    l2g_score = as.numeric(null_na(l2g$score, NA_real_))
  )}))
}

#' Gene labels for the signal map from Open Targets locus-to-gene scores
#'
#' @param cs_meta The `cs_meta` table returned by [ot_credible_sets()] or
#'   [lm_reference_from_ot()].
#' @param min_score Minimum L2G score; weaker assignments are left unlabelled.
#' @return A `data.table` with `cs_id` and `label`, for the `labels` argument
#'   of [lm_plot_signal_map()].
#' @export
lm_labels_from_ot <- function(cs_meta, min_score = 0.5) {
  data.table::as.data.table(cs_meta)[!is.na(l2g_gene) & l2g_score >= min_score,
                                     .(cs_id, label = l2g_gene)]
}

ot_locus_rest <- function(cs_id, have) {
  out <- list()
  page <- have %/% OT_LOCUS_SINGLE_PAGE
  skip <- have %% OT_LOCUS_SINGLE_PAGE
  repeat {
    d <- ot_query(
      paste0("query($id: String!, $p: Int!) { credibleSet(studyLocusId: $id) {
                locus(page: {index: $p, size: ", OT_LOCUS_SINGLE_PAGE, "}) {", LOCUS_FIELDS, "} } }"),
      list(id = cs_id, p = page)
    )
    got <- d$credibleSet$locus$rows
    if (skip) got <- got[-seq_len(min(skip, length(got)))]
    skip <- 0L
    out <- c(out, got)
    if (!length(d$credibleSet$locus$rows) ||
        (page + 1L) * OT_LOCUS_SINGLE_PAGE >= d$credibleSet$locus$count) break
    page <- page + 1L
  }
  out
}

locus_table <- function(cs_id, study_id, loc) {
  if (!length(loc)) return(NULL)
  vid <- vapply(loc, function(x) x$variant$id, "")
  parts <- data.table::tstrsplit(vid, "_", fixed = TRUE)
  mant <- vapply(loc, function(x) as.numeric(null_na(x$pValueMantissa, NA_real_)), 0)
  expo <- vapply(loc, function(x) as.numeric(null_na(x$pValueExponent, NA_real_)), 0)
  data.table::data.table(
    cs_id = cs_id, study_id = study_id, chrom = parts[[1]], pos = as.integer(parts[[2]]),
    variant_id = canonical_variant_id(parts[[1]], parts[[2]], parts[[3]], parts[[4]]),
    pip = vapply(loc, function(x) as.numeric(null_na(x$posteriorProbability, 0)), 0),
    lbf = vapply(loc, function(x) as.numeric(null_na(x$logBF, NA_real_)), 0),
    in_cs = vapply(loc, function(x) isTRUE(x$is95CredibleSet), logical(1)),
    p = mant * 10^expo
  )
}

#' Build a reference set from Open Targets
#'
#' One call from a (filtered) study table to the inputs of
#' [lm_build_registry()].
#'
#' @param studies From [ot_studies()] / [lm_filter_studies()].
#' @param undated What to do with studies without a publication date (e.g.
#'   FinnGen releases): `"drop"`, or `"error"`. Supply dates yourself by
#'   filling `pub_date` before calling.
#' @param progress See [ot_credible_sets()].
#' @return A list with `cs` (credible sets), `studies` (study table with
#'   `study_id`, `pub_date`, `label` and the Open Targets metadata) and
#'   `cs_meta`.
#' @examples
#' \donttest{
#' st <- ot_studies(accessions = c("GCST000435", "GCST001242"))
#' ref <- lm_reference_from_ot(st)
#' reg <- lm_build_registry(ref$cs, ref$studies, lm_even_blocks())
#' }
#' @export
lm_reference_from_ot <- function(studies, undated = c("drop", "error"), progress = interactive()) {
  undated <- match.arg(undated)
  s <- data.table::copy(data.table::as.data.table(studies))
  if (anyNA(s$pub_date)) {
    if (undated == "error") stop("studies without publication date: ",
                                 paste(s[is.na(pub_date)]$study_id, collapse = ", "))
    message("dropping ", sum(is.na(s$pub_date)), " undated stud(ies): ",
            paste(s[is.na(pub_date)]$study_id, collapse = ", "))
    s <- s[!is.na(pub_date)]
  }
  # Several GCST accessions from one paper share a label; keep them apart.
  dup <- s$label %in% s$label[duplicated(s$label)]
  s[dup, label := paste0(label, " (", study_id, ")")]
  cs <- ot_credible_sets(s$study_id, progress = progress)
  list(cs = cs, studies = lm_studies(s), cs_meta = attr(cs, "cs_meta"))
}

#' PICS fine-mapping from a lead variant and its LD
#'
#' For studies that only published top hits (most GWAS before ~2013). Follows
#' Farh et al. (2015) as implemented in Open Targets' Gentropy:
#' `mu = r2 * L`, `sd = sqrt(1 - r^k) * sqrt(L) / 2`, likelihood = two-sided
#' tail of N(mu, sd) beyond the lead's -log10 p `L`; tags with r2 < 0.5 dropped.
#'
#' @param cs_id,study_id,chrom Identifiers of the resulting credible set.
#' @param lead_logp -log10 p of the lead variant.
#' @param tags Data frame with `variant_id`, `pos`, `r2` (to the lead; the lead
#'   itself has r2 = 1), from an ancestry-matched LD panel.
#' @param coverage Credible set coverage.
#' @param min_r2,k PICS parameters.
#' @return A credible-set table (see [lm_credible_sets()]) without lBFs.
#' @examples
#' tags <- data.frame(variant_id = c("1:100:A:G", "1:120:C:T", "1:150:G:T"),
#'                    pos = c(100, 120, 150), r2 = c(1, 0.9, 0.6))
#' pics_credible_set("cs1", "study1", "1", lead_logp = 12, tags = tags)
#' @export
pics_credible_set <- function(cs_id, study_id, chrom, lead_logp, tags,
                              coverage = 0.95, min_r2 = 0.5, k = 6.4) {
  tags <- data.table::as.data.table(tags)[r2 >= min_r2]
  if (!nrow(tags)) stop(cs_id, ": no tag variants with r2 >= ", min_r2)
  r2 <- pmin(pmax(tags$r2, 0), 1)
  mu <- r2 * lead_logp
  sd <- sqrt(1 - sqrt(r2)^k) * sqrt(lead_logp) / 2
  sd[sd == 0] <- 1e-3
  lik <- 2 * stats::pnorm(lead_logp, mu, sd, lower.tail = FALSE)
  pip <- lik / sum(lik)
  o <- order(-pip)
  keep <- seq_len(findInterval(coverage, cumsum(pip[o])) + 1L)
  in_cs <- logical(length(pip))
  in_cs[o[keep]] <- TRUE
  lm_credible_sets(data.table::data.table(
    cs_id = cs_id, study_id = study_id, chrom = chrom, pos = tags$pos,
    variant_id = tags$variant_id, pip = pip, in_cs = in_cs
  ))
}

#' Build the signal registry and classify every credible set
#'
#' Studies are added in publication order. Each credible set (CS) is
#' colocalised with the signals already registered in the LD blocks it touches
#' and labelled:
#'
#' * `replication`: H4 >= `t_h4` with an existing signal (it joins that signal);
#' * `novel_signal`: the block already holds signals, but H3 >= `t_h3` against
#'   every earlier CS there (a new, independent signal in a known locus);
#' * `novel_locus`: no earlier signal in any block the CS touches;
#' * `ambiguous`: neither H3 nor H4 decisive, or a "novel" call that earlier
#'   studies could not have made because they lacked the CS's variants (see
#'   `reference_variants`).
#'
#' Every non-replication opens a new signal. Signal IDs (`<block>#<n>`) are
#' assigned once and never renumbered, so adding studies extends the map but
#' never renames what is already in it. CSs from one study are classified
#' against the registry as it stood before that study, never against each
#' other (CSs from one SuSiE fit are distinct signals by construction).
#'
#' @param cs Credible sets, see [lm_credible_sets()].
#' @param studies Study table, see [lm_studies()].
#' @param blocks LD blocks, see [lm_blocks()].
#' @param t_h4,t_h3 Posterior thresholds for shared / distinct signals.
#' @param reference_variants Optional named list: study ID -> character vector
#'   of variant IDs present in that study's summary statistics or imputation
#'   panel. A "novel" call is downgraded to `ambiguous` when no earlier study
#'   could have tested the CS (see below) carried at least `min_coverage` of the CS's
#'   PIP mass. Studies absent from the list are assumed to cover every variant.
#' @param min_coverage See `reference_variants`.
#' @param ... Priors passed to [coloc_cs()].
#' @return An object of class `lm_registry`: a list with `calls` (one row per
#'   CS), `signals` (one row per signal), `members` (signal-CS membership),
#'   `cs_summary`, `studies` and `tests` (every pairwise colocalisation run).
#' @examples
#' reg <- lm_build_registry(lm_example$cs, lm_example$studies, lm_even_blocks(),
#'                          reference_variants = lm_example$reference_variants)
#' reg
#' head(reg$calls[study_id == "GWAS_2024", .(cs_id, status, signal_id, best_h4)])
#' head(reg$signals)
#' @export
lm_build_registry <- function(cs, studies, blocks, t_h4 = 0.8, t_h3 = 0.8,
                              reference_variants = NULL, min_coverage = 0.5, ...) {
  cs <- lm_credible_sets(cs)
  studies <- lm_studies(studies)
  blocks <- lm_blocks(blocks)
  unknown <- setdiff(unique(cs$study_id), studies$study_id)
  if (length(unknown)) stop("credible sets reference unknown studies: ", paste(unknown, collapse = ", "))

  cs_sum <- summarise_cs(cs)
  cs_sum <- merge(cs_sum, studies[, .(study_id, pub_date)], by = "study_id")
  cs_blocks <- assign_blocks(cs, blocks)
  blocks_of <- split(cs_blocks$block_id, cs_blocks$cs_id)
  by_cs <- split(cs[, .(variant_id, pip, lbf, in_cs)], cs$cs_id)
  lead_block <- assign_blocks(
    cs_sum[, .(cs_id, chrom, pos = lead_pos, in_cs = TRUE)], blocks
  )
  lead_block <- stats::setNames(lead_block$block_id, lead_block$cs_id)

  block_index <- new.env(hash = TRUE)   # block_id -> signal IDs
  counter <- new.env(hash = TRUE)       # anchor block -> last signal number
  members <- list()                     # signal_id -> CS IDs
  signal_flags <- list()
  calls <- vector("list", nrow(cs_sum))
  tests <- list()
  seen_studies <- character()

  for (sid in studies$study_id) {
    this <- cs_sum[study_id == sid]
    if (!nrow(this)) next
    res <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(this)), function(i) {
      row <- this[i]
      blks <- blocks_of[[row$cs_id]]
      flags <- character()
      if (is.null(blks)) flags <- c(flags, "outside_blocks")
      if (in_mhc(row$chrom, row$start, row$end)) flags <- c(flags, "mhc")
      cand <- unique(unlist(lapply(blks, function(b) block_index[[b]])))
      tt <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(cand, function(sig) {
        data.table::rbindlist(lapply(members[[sig]], function(other) {
          r <- coloc_cs(by_cs[[row$cs_id]], by_cs[[other]], ...)
          data.table::data.table(cs_id = row$cs_id, signal_id = sig, other_cs = other,
                                 h3 = r$h3, h4 = r$h4, clpp = r$clpp,
                                 method = r$method, n_shared = r$n_shared)
        }))
      }))
      if (!nrow(tt)) {
        status <- "novel_locus"; best <- NA_character_; best_h4 <- 0
      } else {
        per_sig <- tt[, .(h4 = max(h4), h3_conflict = any(h3 >= t_h3)), by = signal_id]
        data.table::setorder(per_sig, -h4)
        best <- per_sig$signal_id[1]
        best_h4 <- per_sig$h4[1]
        if (best_h4 >= t_h4) {
          status <- "replication"
          if (sum(per_sig$h4 >= t_h4) > 1) flags <- c(flags, "bridges_signals")
          if (per_sig$h3_conflict[1]) flags <- c(flags, "conflict_within_signal")
        } else if (all(tt$h3 >= t_h3)) {
          status <- "novel_signal"
        } else {
          status <- "ambiguous"
        }
      }
      if (status %in% c("novel_signal", "novel_locus") && length(reference_variants)) {
        # Studies without a declared variant universe are assumed to cover the
        # region, so the call is downgraded only if every earlier study is known
        # to have lacked the CS's variants.
        if (length(seen_studies) && all(seen_studies %in% names(reference_variants))) {
          core <- by_cs[[row$cs_id]][in_cs == TRUE]
          cov <- max(vapply(seen_studies, function(s)
            sum(core$pip[core$variant_id %in% reference_variants[[s]]]) / sum(core$pip),
            numeric(1)))
          if (cov < min_coverage) {
            flags <- c(flags, paste0("low_reference_coverage(", status, ")"))
            status <- "ambiguous"
          }
        }
      }
      list(call = data.table::data.table(
        cs_id = row$cs_id, study_id = sid, status = status, best_signal = best,
        best_h4 = best_h4, n_signals_tested = data.table::uniqueN(tt$signal_id),
        flags = paste(flags, collapse = ";")
      ), tests = tt)
    })

    # Commit the study after all its CSs were classified.
    for (r in res) {
      cl <- r$call
      if (cl$status == "replication") {
        sig <- cl$best_signal
        members[[sig]] <- c(members[[sig]], cl$cs_id)
      } else {
        anchor <- lead_block[cl$cs_id]
        if (is.na(anchor)) anchor <- paste0(this[cs_id == cl$cs_id]$chrom, ":unmapped")
        n <- (if (is.null(counter[[anchor]])) 0L else counter[[anchor]]) + 1L
        counter[[anchor]] <- n
        sig <- paste0(anchor, "#", n)
        members[[sig]] <- cl$cs_id
        signal_flags[[sig]] <- if (cl$status == "ambiguous") "provisional" else ""
      }
      for (b in blocks_of[[cl$cs_id]]) {
        if (!sig %in% block_index[[b]]) block_index[[b]] <- c(block_index[[b]], sig)
      }
      cl[, signal_id := sig]
      calls[[match(cl$cs_id, cs_sum$cs_id)]] <- cl
      tests[[length(tests) + 1L]] <- r$tests
    }
    seen_studies <- c(seen_studies, sid)
  }

  calls <- data.table::rbindlist(calls)
  members_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(names(members), function(s)
    data.table::data.table(signal_id = s, cs_id = members[[s]])))
  members_dt <- merge(members_dt, cs_sum[, .(cs_id, study_id, pub_date)], by = "cs_id")
  members_dt <- merge(members_dt, calls[, .(cs_id, status)], by = "cs_id")
  data.table::setorder(members_dt, signal_id, pub_date)

  founders <- members_dt[, .SD[1], by = signal_id]
  signals <- merge(founders[, .(signal_id, founder_cs = cs_id, first_study = study_id,
                                first_reported = pub_date)],
                   cs_sum[, .(founder_cs = cs_id, chrom, lead_pos, lead_variant)],
                   by = "founder_cs")
  signals <- merge(signals, members_dt[, .(n_studies = data.table::uniqueN(study_id),
                                           studies = paste(unique(study_id), collapse = ";")),
                                       by = signal_id], by = "signal_id")
  signals[, flags := vapply(signal_id, function(s) {
    f <- signal_flags[[s]]; if (is.null(f)) "" else f
  }, character(1))]
  signals[, mhc := in_mhc(chrom, lead_pos, lead_pos)]
  data.table::setcolorder(signals, c("signal_id", "chrom", "lead_pos", "lead_variant"))

  structure(list(
    calls = merge(calls, cs_sum, by = c("cs_id", "study_id")),
    signals = signals[],
    members = members_dt[],
    studies = studies,
    tests = data.table::rbindlist(tests, fill = TRUE),
    params = list(t_h4 = t_h4, t_h3 = t_h3)
  ), class = "lm_registry")
}

#' @export
print.lm_registry <- function(x, ...) {
  cat(sprintf("<lm_registry> %d studies, %d credible sets, %d signals\n",
              nrow(x$studies), nrow(x$calls), nrow(x$signals)))
  tab <- x$calls[, .N, by = .(study_id, status)]
  tab <- data.table::dcast(tab, study_id ~ status, value.var = "N", fill = 0)
  tab <- tab[match(x$studies$study_id, study_id)][!is.na(study_id)]
  print(tab)
  invisible(x)
}
